Get internal lookup table for the 27-item MCQ

Source: R/mcq.R
get_lookup_table.Rd

Get internal lookup table for the 27-item MCQ

Usage

get_lookup_table()

Value

Data frame with the complete Kirby, Petry, & Bickel (1999) 27-item design: questionid, magnitude, kindiff, k_rank, ss_amount, ll_amount, and delay (days)

Examples

get_lookup_table()
#>    questionid magnitude     kindiff  k_rank ss_amount ll_amount delay
